title: A CSV input validated without its refused records suppresses each coverage gap, a finding about the array as a whole, and counts it
notes: Records 1 and 3 are refused alone, for a bare quote and text after a closing quote, and the other three are validated as an array of three. The validated records hold 1.1.1 and 1.3.1, so coverage misses 1.2.1 and 2.1.1, each held only by a refused record. Both gaps are findings about the array as a whole, so neither is reported, and input.validation.partial counts them in suppressed.
